tool_resolution: No playwright.config.*, cypress.config.*, @playwright/test dep, cypress dep, or custom command in .ai-run/sdlc-factory/config.json found

change_summary: HelpItem icons changed from alt={name} to alt='' role='presentation' (decorative), and SVG Icon gains aria-hidden='true' — pure accessibility attribute change, no route or interaction change
